types.name: UpdateProductsStepInput
types.description: The details of the products update.

children.name: selector
children.description: The filters to select the products to update.

children.name: $and
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.

children.name: $or
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "or" condition.

children.name: q
children.description: Search through the products' attributes, such as titles and descriptions, using this search term.

children.name: option_value_id
children.description: Filter a product by the IDs of the associated option values.

children.name: categories
children.description: Filter a product by the IDs of their associated categories.

children.name: collection_id
children.description: Filters a product by its associated collections.

children.name: created_at
children.description: Filters a product based on when it was created

children.name: updated_at
children.description: Filters a product based on when it was updated

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: Filters soft-deleted products based on the date they were deleted at.

children.name: handle
children.description:
The handle of the product. The handle can be used to create slug URL paths.
If not supplied, the value of the `handle` attribute of the product is set to the slug version of the `title` attribute.
